question: Should Crabbox own and release this first-party Zed extension and its dedicated CI surface from this repository?
rationale: The patch creates a new editor-specific distribution and long-term maintenance surface; source correctness alone cannot determine whether that ownership belongs in Crabbox or an independently maintained extension.

options.title: Own it after live proof
options.body: Accept the in-repository extension direction after a real Zed installation and Crabbox lifecycle run are demonstrated and supported platforms are explicit.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish and maintain the Zed extension separately while Crabbox documents it as a community integration.

recommendation.title: Own it after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the in-repository extension direction after a real Zed installation and Crabbox lifecycle run are demonstrated and supported platforms are explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of interactive handoff and user-facing runtime surfaces that this extension would join.
